H4.group_summary: H4 extract of six files: one DEU SR worldline-clock audit notebook and five LIGO ringdown model-comparison scripts. (1) DEU_SR_Worldline_Clock_Audit.ipynb is a driver over a SCHEDULER_FOAM cap-512 activation-foam sample; it runs light-cone-boundary and tube-clock time-dilation audits in graph radar coordinates against Minkowski 2+1D/3+1D and random-DAG controls, with named observables (edge_rnorm_q90_median ~ 1, near_minus_bulk_v > 0, gamma_cg vs gamma_target, tau_ratio, monotone fractions) whose formulas live in unread %run patch files; the saved notebook contains only error outputs (NameError/RuntimeError), so no computed results are recorded in it. (2-6) The LIGO chain is PROJECTION_ONLY throughout: Experiment 02 (script form) fits GR / uniform-eta (eta=40/41) / DEU sine-compression f_c*sin(eta*f/f_c) / free-scale frequency ladders to whitened GW150914 strain via equal-parameter linear least squares, ranked by BIC (thresholds 10/6/2, pass at delta-BIC>=6 and offsource p<=0.05); 02B adds a look-elsewhere-matched offsource null with add-one p and a cutoff-boundary flag (documents that the first run preferred fc=700 Hz at the grid boundary); 02C ablates nested mode subsets and defines incremental high-mode-leverage diagnostics (records the 02B verbal result: DEU beat GR and uniform-eta but not the FREE_SCALE control); 02D computes family-level (max-over-mode-subsets) plain and strict look-elsewhere p-values plus per-detector H1/L1 consistency; p6_phase0a_killcheck replaces the toy ladder [250,395,525,645] Hz with Kerr QNM ladders from the GWTC-1 GW150914 remnant (Mf=63.1 Msun, chi=0.69, z=0.09) and adds a KERR_REMNANT control over the remnant 90% credible region, event-window only. Tier-D quantities recorded include eta=40/41, the toy ladder Hz/ms values, GPS 1126259462.422, GWTC-1 remnant parameters, MSUN_SEC=4.925490947e-6, and all grid/threshold constants. Only spatial claims are graph-internal (near-null vs bulk radar speed in the foam notebook). No saturation-type claims requiring H3 classification; historical numeric values appear only as fc=700 Hz boundary railing and the qualitative 02B/02C outcome statements quoted in docstrings.
